notes.title: The Steam store page for "Comical Sara" is now available!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! I'm KurokumaSoft, a game developer.
Today I am pleased to announce the release of the Steam store page for my new FPS "[b]Comical Sara[/b]".

This game is [b]a roguelite FPS[/b] where you can shoot bullets without reloading. You will shoot hordes of enemies in levels that change every time you play.

Development of the game is currently well underway and I will be releasing a time-limited demo in time for the Steam Next Fest in 2025. If you are interested in this game, please add it to your wishlist and look forward to seeing the demo.

I will let you know when I am ready to release the demo.
See you soon!
